_about: Parameters of the Phase 2 protocol (README.md). Part I (pilot) and Part II (scaling decision) feed Part III (formal comparison). Values marked 'set_at' are fixed later by the stated rule: pilot plans in pilot-plan.json, scaling choices in scaling-decision.json, formal values in protocol-freeze.json. Changes to this file need a dated revision entry in README.md before the affected measurement.

history.content: cloud-first design with two same-day amendments; frozen, never measured
restructured before any measurement: a pilot on available machines and a recorded scaling decision precede the formal comparison; formal machines come from that decision

T-ref-est.order: global round-robin g = j*15 + c, contiguous prefix only

stream.name: sf-stream-v1
stream.replicates: 0 for fixed-n tasks; H4 launch pair i uses 10(i-1)+1 .. 10i

t_diag._note: count_3 equals sfloor_1.5; L_32 and q_16 equal count_24 (canonical). Unlisted L/q take the canonical values.
t_diag.model: t = b0 + b1*C + b2*Cw + b3*W + b4*P (+ b5/b on GPU); NNLS on rows scaled by 1/t_obs

lab-desktop.description: Lab PC: Intel Core Ultra 5 250K Plus (hybrid P/E cores, 18 logical CPUs), 32 GiB host RAM (WSL2 sees about 15 GiB), NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti 8 GB (sm_120), Windows 11 + WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04. Execution and measurement only
limits: shared machine with a display: free VRAM varies
WSL2: no GPU persistence mode, page cache drop needs root inside the VM

colab.description: Google Colab session. The assigned GPU, host CPU, RAM and session length vary per session; each session is recorded and treated as its own hardware
colab.cuda_arch: per assigned GPU (sm_75 T4, sm_89 L4, sm_80 A100)
limits: assignment and session limits vary (official FAQ)
results are written to the VM's local disk; copies to Drive happen after the timed region

c7i.16xlarge.description: 32 cores / 64 vCPU Xeon Platinum 8488C, 128 GiB; the Phase 1 CPU

pilot.rule: one available machine suffices; both are not required
pilot.session_rule: different times of day; each session records its own environment

cold_kinds.cache-cold: new process after the page cache was dropped
cold_kinds.process-cold: new process; the page cache could not be dropped. Aggregated separately from cache-cold

steps.cpu-baseline: T1/T2 on both series, cold and warm, CPU with every logical CPU
steps.threads: CPU thread/affinity candidates from the machine's topology, short + sustained design
steps.rates: steady-state rates per (series, grid, L) at the chosen CPU configuration and at each validated GPU configuration; inputs of the time projection
steps.gpu-rates: G-inc and G-hyb at a small point and at the representative point, each at microbatch 64 and auto
steps.microbatch: GPU microbatch sweep up to b_max, with memory records; allocation failures are results
steps.gpu-tasks: T1/T2 on both series, cold and warm, on each GPU path that passed the device gate
steps.diag: T-diag points of the calibration split only (N in calibration_n), CPU and validated GPU paths
steps.tref-rates: steady-state rate of every T-ref cell (projection of the reference build)
steps.tref-build: the exact T-ref reference and its oracle, if the available hours allow
steps.deadline: deadline behaviour on a small problem (week prefix of 75,600 bars), budgets 2 and 5 s

pilot.thread_candidates: from the observed topology: P-core set (if the P/E mapping is known), all physical cores, all logical CPUs; Colab: within the allocated CPUs. Formal-machine counts are never carried over
pilot.projection_vs_observed: pilot projections of T1/T2 are compared with the observed warm E2E on the same machine before they are used for T-ref
never: used to choose m, Delta, tasks, accuracy targets or cells
a prefix reference used in place of the full-week reference for H4
a slow or failed run discarded

actions.none: report the available-machine results; formal H3/H4 are 'not measured (no scaling)'
actions.environment: move to a controllable machine of a similar class (repeatable launches, controlled cold state)
actions.cpu-host: a larger CPU or GPU host CPU

scaling.projection_time: T = T_setup + sum_c n_c / r_c + T_output; r_c measured on that machine, code, grid, length and strength; scenarios from the slowest, median and fastest repetition; lengths outside the measured range are flagged as extrapolated
scaling.projection_memory: M = M_shared + b * M_trial (+ M_temporary), compared with the measured allocation (free at context creation - free after our allocations); free memory is read after context creation and before our allocations
scaling.verification: the same workload re-run on the target machine; gain = baseline / observed (times) or observed / baseline (rates); 'supported' if gain >= the record's threshold, 'not supported' if below, 'indeterminate' if a run is missing or failed. Descriptive: one machine per side, no interval
scaling.budget_rule: the cap is not raised automatically; the scaling record re-estimates all paid work from pilot rates and must fit the remaining cap

verdicts.interval: paired t, 90%, on log ratios over launch pairs
verdicts._optimisation_go_ratio: decides only how much GPU optimisation effort goes in before the freeze; never a criterion for scaling

short.select: max geometric mean over lengths of median throughput

sustained.rule: if the sustained order disagrees with the short selection, use the sustained winner and record the flip

thread_calibration.gpu_batch: same design over {64, 256, 1024, b_max}; sustained check between the two best
thread_calibration.candidates: machines[profile].thread_candidates; a GPU host: physical cores and all vCPUs

deadline.drain_margin_rule: 1.5 x max(exit - stop) over 20 calibration runs (10 at 10 s, 10 at 300 s), rounded up to 10 ms

cost_basis.price: official AWS on-demand price list, us-east-1 Linux, run date; SKU and file SHA-256 recorded
cost_basis.spot: zone spot price at launch and hours lost to interruptions, reported separately

resource_records: worker affinity at loop start and end

set_at.threads: Stage A on the formal CPU; repeated before the freeze if CPU-best changed
set_at.m: Stage A, from formal CPU launches only
set_at.cpu_best: parity rule on the formal CPU, freeze
set_at.gpu_path: path selection on the formal GPU
set_at.batch: pre-freeze calibration on the formal GPU
set_at.drain_margin: pre-freeze calibration on the formal machines
set_at.timeouts: pre-freeze calibration on the formal CPU
set_at.warmup_trials: pre-freeze calibration on the formal machines
